subtitle.chooseModelType: Choose a model type to get started

actions.switchWarning: Save or discard changes before switching tabs.

tabs.yamlDescription: Edit the YAML directly. The model name must be set in the YAML for create to work.

modelName.label: Model Name
modelName.hint: Use letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, and dots only.

empty.nav: Use the search bar above to add fields
empty.title: No fields configured
empty.text: Use the search bar above to find and add configuration fields.

proxyVision.label: This model can look at images
proxyVision.hint: Turn this on when the upstream model accepts images. LocalAI cannot check it. Attached images then go to the model with the message.

runtime.title: Runtime tuning
runtime.lead: How llama.cpp loads and runs this model. Each field is a llama-server flag. An empty field keeps the default.
runtime.loadModeHint: How the model file is read. Writes mmap, mmlock and the direct_io option.

errors.colon: A colon cuts the value short. Remove it.
errors.empty: Type an entry, or remove the row.
errors.rawOwned: {{name}} is set by a field above. Use that field.
errors.layerRange: Each range needs a start and an end layer, with the end not before the start.
errors.overrideTarget: The buffer name can only have letters, digits and underscores: {{target}}
errors.overrideRegex: This pattern is not a valid regular expression: {{entry}}

ot.title: Tensor placement

modes.rest: First N layers on GPU, experts of the rest on CPU
modes.ranges: Experts of chosen layers on CPU

help.experts: Keeps the expert weights of every layer in system memory. The rest of the model stays on the GPU.
help.rest: Keeps the first N layers on the GPU and the experts of every later layer on the CPU. With the total number of layers, the pattern lists the rest as one range.
help.ranges: Keeps the experts of the layers you choose in system memory, for example 0-6 and 18-23.
help.raw: Writes the value as you type it.

ot.gpuLayers: Layers with experts on the GPU
ot.rawHint: Comma-separated pattern=buffer entries, as in llama-server -ot.
ot.failed: The server could not build the pattern: {{message}}

bigMoe.name: Big MoE on a small GPU
bigMoe.text: All layers on the GPU, experts on the CPU, 8-bit KV cache.

maxContext.name: Max context
maxContext.text: 128K context, flash attention and an 8-bit KV cache.

lowVram.name: Low VRAM
lowVram.text: 4K context, a 4-bit KV cache and a small micro-batch.

applied.title: {{name}}: {{count}} settings changed.
applied.none: Nothing changed. The form already had these values.
applied.note: The fields stay editable. Nothing is saved until you save the model.

raw.title: Advanced options
raw.hint: Other entries of the options list, one per row: name:value, or a llama-server flag such as --rope-scale:2.

preview.title: Command preview
preview.note: The llama-server command these settings match. LocalAI starts the backend itself; this line is for comparison and for use outside LocalAI.

paste.title: Paste a llama-server command
paste.hint: Flags with a field fill that field. Flags with no field are kept as raw options and listed below.
paste.failed: The command could not be read.
paste.modelFile: The command uses the model file {{file}}.
paste.modelFileKept: This model keeps {{file}} until you choose otherwise.
paste.unmappedNote: A flag with no field is kept as a raw option and passed to llama.cpp as written. Remove the ones you do not want.

schemaError.title: Runtime tuning is not available.
schemaError.body: The server did not send the llama.cpp settings ({{message}}). You can still edit every setting as text in the other tab of this editor.

readOnly.title: Read only.
readOnly.body: Only an administrator can change these settings.
